## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `mistral-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to API keys

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [Mistral AI console](https://console.mistral.ai/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the API Keys panel in the left sidebar. -->
3. <!-- manual: Select a plan based on your requirements. -->

## Step 3: Create an API key

1. Select **Create new key**.
2. Enter a name for the key and fill in any required details, then select **Create new key**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a name for the key and fill in any required details, then select Create new key. -->
4. <!-- manual: Copy the generated API key immediately — it will not be shown again. -->
